sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Dhan Pal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga for the State and perused the record.

2.  The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 153 of 2022, under Sections-498A, 304B, 201 IPC and Sections-3/4 of D. P. Act, police station Sahawar,
District Kasganj, with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.
3. It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is husband of the deceased and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
The marriage of deceased with applicant has taken place about two years prior to the incident.

Out of that marriage they have a daughter,
who is presently being looked after wife relative of applicant.
Only general allegations of dowry demand and harassment of deceased have been levelled against all the accused persons, including the applicant.

It was stated that the applicant accused has made statement to the police during investigation that on 15.06.2022, a quarrel has taken place between deceased and his brother and applicant has supported his brother, due to which the deceased committed suicide by hanging in fit Roopkishor vs State Of U.P. on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186404932/
1 of rage.
It is further submitted that the allegation that after incident, the family members of the deceased were not informed, is wholly false.
The cremation of the deceased was done with the consent of family members of the deceased.
Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in jail since 16.08.2022, and thus, he has already undergone the detention of more than two years and trial of the case would take sufficient long time.
It was stated that the applicant has no criminal history and that in case, the applicant-accused is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail and will co-operate in trial.
4. Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is husband of the deceased and she has suffered death due to hanging within seven years of her marriage.
5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Roopkishor involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant will not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant will not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant will not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 6.11.2024 / RKM  Roopkishor vs State Of U.P. on 6 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186404932/
